purpose: Dedicated original dark-mode assets, replacing the rejected tint treatment

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production artwork for Workbench, a premium native macOS AI creative studio in DARK MODE. Render a NEW scene conceived and lit for darkness, not an existing light illustration with a dark filter. Coherent art direction: refined photoreal 3D product miniature, graphite metal and smoked glass, tactile materials, physically plausible soft reflections, carefully controlled colored rim lighting, deep navy shadows, expensive editorial product photography. Keep all corners and backdrop dark with no white or pale gray studio backdrop, no overexposure, no white mist, no flat gray veil. Polished yet quiet, usable behind interface labels. No logos, watermark, letters, slogans, readable code, labels, UI frames, borders, collages, or multiple panels. No people, cartoon characters, cyberpunk city, rainbow glow or clutter. Panoramic extra-wide horizontal hero banner, ideally 3000x500 (6:1). Background and left 50% are a beautifully clean uninterrupted midnight navy #121B26, with subtle depth, ready for white heading text that will be added by the app. Scene concentrated on the RIGHT, centered at x=76%, y=52%: one elegant translucent midnight-blue glass intelligence core, a small brushed dark metal base and a single thin orbital light arc, with only two understated smoked glass floating planes behind it. A convincing sculptural centerpiece, cool steel-blue and muted teal highlights. The entire core and arc must remain compact in the central horizontal band so a shallow banner crop preserves the whole object. Right edge, top and bottom gently fall into #121B26, matching a dark app canvas. No text including no 'AI' lettering. Make this a beautiful original night studio hero.
